boxes.title: Rudrama: added
items: Second great woman ruler after **Razia Sultana**
Tripurantakam inscription (**1266**) still calls her Ganapati's vassal
Vengi regained when **Poti Nayaka**, Prolinayaka beat **Virabhanudeva**
Died with general **Mallikarjuna Nayaka**; Chandupatla in **Nalgonda**

cards.title: Economy
lines: Forests → farmland; tanks, wells; new villages

boxes.title: Invasions: added
items: **1310**: **Amir Khusrau** accompanied Kafur; ==double-walled fort with moat==
**1311**: Kakatiya forces joined Kafur's march on **Madurai**

boxes.title: More sources & legacy
items: **Agastya**: Nalakirtikaumudi, Balabharata, Krishnacharita; court poet **Sakalya Malla**
Marco Polo: travelled **1271-1295**; Coromandel ==**1292**==; hot climate, loincloths
Survivors of **75** generals: **Prolaya Nayaka**, **Racherla Singama**, **Prolaya Vema** → Musunuri, Reddi states
